# Auctionator Remastered 0.9.0-beta.2

Beta update for **World of Warcraft 3.3.5a**, tested on **Warmane**.

## Changes

- New warm anthracite standard-WoW styling for Buy, Sell, Undercuts, Deals, Trading Logs, Full Scan, Offline Browser, Shopping Planner and price history, with clearer panel borders and distinct background surfaces.
- Improved Sell control spacing, aligned Buy shopping-list buttons and consistent upper-right close buttons.
- Existing ElvUI styling and layout are preserved.
- Fixed a bag-update Lua error caused by other group members disenchanting items.
- Sell results now refresh after confirmed postings; overlapping confirmations and failed batches no longer add duplicate or unconfirmed auctions.

## Installation and updating

Download **Auctionator-Remastered-WotLK-0.9.0-beta.2.zip** below. Close WoW, back up your addon folders and `WTF` directory, then extract both `AuctionatorRemastered` and `AuctionatorRemastered_Startup` into `Interface/AddOns/`.

Replace both addon folders when updating. Existing Remastered database data is preserved. Disable other Auctionator versions and Auctionator MiniFeatures.

[Full patch notes](https://github.com/andreash-dev/Auctionator-Remastered-WotLK/blob/main/RELEASE_CHANGELOG.md) · [Installation and features](https://github.com/andreash-dev/Auctionator-Remastered-WotLK#installation)
